title.narrative: Towards quality TB and lung disease care and prevention through revamped health systems that ensure high-quality healthcare for all Kenyans

description.narrative: Kenya - Tuberculosis - Amref Health Africa - Amref Kenya. This program has the following goals: To ensure provision of quality care and prevention services for TB,and lung diseases for all people in Kenya. To achieve equitable, affordable, accessible and high quality care for all.. The objectives of this program are: Reduce TB incidence rate by 80% by 2030 compared to 2015 baseline. Reduce TB mortality rate by 90% by 2030 compared to 2015 baseline. Zero families facing caterstrophic cost due to TB and chronic lung disease
